programme.title: When I was Your Age #25
When I was Your Age #25
programme.sub-title: Paul, 10, is a typical little boy. He goes to school, he plays sports, he is secretly in love, he tries to do as little as possible at home, he confuses his parents to get what he
programme.desc: Paul, 10, is a typical little boy. He goes to school, he plays sports, he is secretly in love, he tries to do as little as possible at home, he confuses his parents to get what he wants. And most of all, he would like them to finally understand that he’s not a baby anymore and is old enough to do things ON HIS OWN! Except that... he has a strange gift... or curse... As soon as someone says the words, “When I was your age...” Paul is immediately hurled back to the time when the person he is talking to was 10 years old like he is now. He can shoot back 20, 30...70 years in time! Before mobile phones existed... When boys and girls didn't go to the same school... When there was only one television station... When toilets were at the far end of the yard... In other words, for a boy in 2021: ancient history! So as soon as he hears, “When I was your age,” gasp, gulp, where and when will he land this time? And in what completely crazy situation?”

now Report #518

programme.desc: 顧時間短,貼合香港的居住環境與生活節奏;又指年輕人可能會以飼養異寵,視為展現個人獨特性與自我形象的文化資本。有開業多年的角蛙店負責人指,近年顧客量與生意額上升五至六倍,又指對許多工作繁忙的都市人來說,這類動物無聲的陪伴,成了下班後最療癒的解藥。熱潮背後,有關注動物權益人士認為,不少人可能因獵奇或一時衝動飼養異寵,忽視了牠們對濕度、溫度等環境的要求;亦有獸醫指,另類寵物容易隱藏病徵,主人可能因醫療知識不足,令異寵錯過最佳的治療時機;有兩棲及爬蟲類動物福利機構指,棄養個案連年上升,市民可能因追求新寵物品種,間接令非法走私活動變得頻繁。究竟,香港的環境、氣候,寵物主人的知識和心態,是否適宜飼養異寵呢?

programme.title: 名廚招牌菜[英]
My Greatest Dishes[Eng]
programme.sub-title: 30多年來,大衛湯普森一直是烹飪界的奠基石。他是泰國菜的愛好者,在倫敦、曼谷、悉尼和首爾都有餐廳。他獲得無數榮譽,並撰寫了歷來最成功的烹飪書之一,而弘揚正宗泰國菜的使命仍然是他所做的一切的核心。

David Thompson has been a corner stone of the culinary world for over thirty years. A devotee of Thai cuisine, he's had restaurants in London, Bangkok, Sydney and Seoul. Awarded countless accolades and author of one the most
programme.desc: successful cook books of all time, his mission to celebrate authentic Thai cuisine still lies at the core of everything he does.

programme.title: 藍海世界[英]
Blue World[Eng]
programme.sub-title: 喬納森到喜愛的潛水地: 佛羅里達的藍鷺橋. 他不是首次到這裡, 今次希望找到罕見的瞻星魚. 這種魚極難找. 接著他跟太太姬斯汀及兒子里安到麻省潛水, 見見愛玩耍的海豹. 原來海豹很愛查察他們的蛙鞋!

Jonathan goes to one of his favorite dive sites, the Blue Heron Bridge in Riviera Beach, Florida. It's not the first time that he's here. This time, he hopes to find a rare and amazing fish: The Stargazer. This fish is really
programme.desc: difficult to find. Then he invites his wife Christine and son Liam to go meet playful seals in Massachusetts. It turns out that seals love to investigate fins!

programme.title: 明珠雜誌[英]
Pearl Magazine[Eng]
programme.sub-title: Hong Kong is known for being an international financial hub and a major trading port, so developing a career in theatre is not the target of many university graduates. Yet, some have decided to give up a conventional job to
programme.desc: pursue their dream career on stage. Others passionate about theatre must balance their theatre goal and a day job to make ends meet.

programme.title: 異獸世界[英]
Impossible Animals[Eng]
programme.sub-title: 在本集中,生物學家柏德烈亞伊向我們介紹了生活在世界上最惡劣的地方之一,沙漠中的不可思議的動物。由於地面溫度超過攝氏70度,為了在這裡生存,生物已經發展了一些巧妙的適應能力。

In this episode, biologist Patrick Aryee introduces us to the incredible animals living in one of the world's toughest places, deserts. With ground temperatures exceeding 70degrees C, to survive here creatures have developed
programme.desc: some ingenious adaptations.

programme.title: 我要做廚神 : 澳洲篇[英]
MasterChef Australia[Eng]
programme.sub-title: 15位參賽者來到美食家的終極樂園,進行團隊賽。他們分成兩隊,設計並烹調海陸雙併套餐,供應在場的一千六百位食客。他們要在五小時內烹調食物,勝出那隊可進入下一場豁免賽,爭奪全體淘汰賽的豁免權。

The 15 cooks are taken to the ultimate playground for foodies for a team challenge. They are split into 2 teams and prepare a surf and turf street food menu to serve 1,600 people. The teams have 5 hours to prepare all their
programme.desc: food before the masses descend upon them. The top team will progress to the next immunity challenge, where they will compete for safety from an all-in elimination.

programme.title: 我要做廚神 : 澳洲篇[英]
MasterChef Australia[Eng]
programme.sub-title: 在今季最大型的豁免賽,獎品除了下場淘汰賽豁免權,還有一萬澳元禮券和爭奪豁免徽章的機會。在第一回合,參賽者要在75分鐘內只用一種電器下廚,勝出後才可進入第二回合,與曾在世界最佳餐廳掌廚的大廚一較高下。

In the biggest immunity challenge yet, not only is immunity for the next elimination up for grabs, but also a $10,000 voucher and the opportunity to win an immunity pin. In round 1, each contestant creates a dish in 75
programme.desc: minutes using only the kitchen appliances in the gift box on their bench. The winner of round 1 cooks off against a professional chef who had worked for the best restaurant in the world.

programme.title: 鯊魚百科[英]
Shark Dive TV[Eng]
programme.sub-title: 今集,我們將在屬於西印度洋一部分的阿曼灣碧綠海水中尋找斑馬鯊,並前往菲律賓觀看令人驚嘆的鯨鯊表演。最後,深入探討捕鯊割鰭的不人道做法和長尾鯊的特性。

In this episode, we'll search for Zebra Sharks in the greenish blue water of the Gulf of Oman, part of the western Indian Ocean and travel to the Philippines for an amazing whale shark performance. Lastly, we'll do a Deeper Dive
programme.desc: calling out the inhumane practise of shark finning and a deeper dive into the world of the thresher shark.

programme.title: 節拍小天地[英]
Backyard Beats[Eng]
programme.sub-title: 和Monica一起投入《節拍小天地》。她利用環保回收箱中收集的日常物品,自製手工藝樂器。專業音樂家和少年樂手會到節拍小天地中即興表演。他們的樂器是Monica製作的手工藝樂器的靈感來源。

Join Monica as she builds DIY craft-struments from everyday items that can be found in a recycling bin. Along for the ride are Pro Musicians and Junior Jammers who visit the backyard for a jam session. Their instruments are the
programme.desc: inspiration for Monicas craftstruments builds. Each episode concludes with Monica and her friends making some Backyard Beats!

programme.title: 明珠絕色:野性美洲[英]
Pearl Spectacular:The Americas[Eng]
programme.sub-title: 加勒比地區充滿出乎意料的野生動物故事。旗魚以速度與合作捕獵沙甸魚。數百萬紅蟹展開大遷徙,到海裡產卵。紫喉加利蜂鳥守護花蜜豐富的花朵。捲尾猴運用石頭敲開果仁,展現適應力與智慧。

The Caribbean is rich with surprising wildlife stories. Sailfish use speed and coordination to hunt sardines. Millions of red crabs undertake a massive migration to lay their eggs. Purple-throated Carib
programme.desc: hummingbirds defend their nectar-rich flowers. Capuchin monkeys cleverly use stone tools to crack nuts, a rare glimpse into their adaptability and intelligence.

programme.title: 優遊假期[英]
Luxury Escapes[Eng]
programme.sub-title: 荷莉和祖絲結伴同遊印尼。第一站去松巴島一個豪華度假中心,參與水療獵奇、享受漂浮早餐、並騎馬在海中馳騁。然後她們再去峇里島,繼續享受優遊假期。

Holly Kingston and Jules Robinson travel together to Indonesia. First they head to Sumba, a quiet island that has been voted the world's best resort two years in a row. They stay at NIHI, do a spa safari, enjoy a floating
programme.desc: breakfast and go horse riding in the ocean. Then they go on to Bali for another treat.

programme.title: 七點半新聞報道[英]
NEWS AT SEVEN-THIRTY[Eng]
programme.sub-title: 明珠台每日晚上七時半,以英語報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞,讓���洞悉各地大事。

programme.title: 天氣報告[英] 及 100道風味[英]
WEATHER REPORT[Eng] and Top 100 National Dishes[Eng]
藍海世界[英]
Blue World[Eng]
programme.sub-title: 喬納森與家人前去葡萄牙的埃斯皮切爾角海岸。那裏有個名為柳珊瑚園的熱門潛水地點,但喬納森卻希望看到一個章魚園。然後他與攝製隊去麻省‧埃弗里特,探索一隻被巨浪劈成兩半而沉下海底的運油船。

Jonathan and his family travel to the rugged coast of Portugal's Cape Espichel, to visit a popular dive site known as Garden of the Gorgonians, where Jonathan hopes to find an octopus garden instead. Then Jonathan and his film crew
programme.desc: go to Gloucester, Massachusetts, to explore the wreck of the Chester Poling, a tanker hit and broken in half by a huge wave.

programme.title: 獵食戰場[英]
Predator Countdown[Eng]
programme.sub-title: 在南美環境惡劣的野外, 最強韌的動物正面交鋒. 為撫養孩子, 美洲獅媽媽要冒死獵食高大強壯的原駝. 連水虎魚及虎鯨都要跟同伴合作獵食. 所有掠食者和獵物都生活艱難, 都要為每一頓美食竭力爭取.

In South America's harsh environment, toughest animals have battled it out on the open grasslands. To raise the family, puma mums fight against big and strong guanacos at the risk of their own lives. Even piranhas and orcas
programme.desc: have to hunt in groups for food. In the wild, all predators and prey face a hard life. Animal inhabitants must scramble to find every single meal.

In this episode, we explore the world of freshwater - the lifeblood of planet Earth and the stage for extraordinary animal dramas. Gliding tree frogs gather in the newly formed pond to breed, mugger crocodiles lurk in the
programme.desc: waterhole to hunt, millions of goby fish climb to the top of a 30-metre waterfall, Indus river dolphins get trapped in the network of irrigation canals, and so much more.

This time, we'll learn that watermelons are bite-sized to a hippo; some caterpillars are scared to use the passing lane; pandas have a dark side; flower-pot water is the secret to doggy hydration; sometimes you don't want to
programme.desc: play through and you should never let your guard down.

In South America's harsh environment, toughest animals have battled it out on the open grasslands. To raise the family, puma mums fight against big and strong guanacos at the risk of their own lives. Even piranhas and orcas
programme.desc: have to hunt in groups for food. In the wild, all predators and prey face a hard life. Animal inhabitants must scramble to find every single meal.

Audra journeys to Sibu, the heart of Sarawak's Fuchow community, to uncover its rich culinary traditions and heritage. Guided by local chefs, artisans and farming families, she explores bustling markets, legendary kompia,
programme.desc: handmade mee sua, and the prized dabai fruit. Through authentic food experiences and heartfelt encounters, Audra discovers how generations of tradition, craftsmanship and hospitality continue to shape Sibu's unique identity.

Sashi discovers the artistry behind traditional betutu bebek, where generations-old techniques transform humble ingredients into unforgettable flavors. Guided by chef Reynaldo, he forages through lush jungles, gathers fresh local
programme.desc: produce, and prepares a simple dessert in the wild. Together, they celebrate Bali's rich culinary heritage, and deep cultural traditions.

programme.sub-title: 今集,伊娃探索北部的崎嶇阿斯圖里亞斯,揭示其豐富的烹飪遺產和鄉郊傳統。從有百年歷史的蘋果酒釀製,到在山洞製作的卡布拉爾斯芝士,我們跟居民和芝士製造商等一起了解大地和社區如何塑造當地食物。

Eva explores Asturias, Spain's rugged northern region, uncovering its rich culinary heritage and rural traditions. Alongside passionate cheesemakers and musician Rodrigo Cuevas, Eva explores Asturias' stunning
programme.desc: mountains, fading villages, traditional farming, and the people preserving its distinctive culture.

Maximum Foodie[Eng]
programme.sub-title: 薩希探索傳統烤鴨背後的傳統,世代相傳的技巧把簡樸食材變成難忘的味道。在大廚雷納爾多帶領下,他深入叢林找新鮮食材,並在野外炮製簡單甜品,從而表揚峇里的豐富美食遺產和文化傳統。

Sashi discovers the artistry behind traditional betutu bebek, where generations-old techniques transform humble ingredients into unforgettable flavors. Guided by chef Reynaldo, he forages through lush jungles, gathers fresh local
programme.desc: produce, and prepares a simple dessert in the wild. Together, they celebrate Bali's rich culinary heritage, and deep cultural traditions.

programme.title: 靚太西班牙美食行[英]
Eva Longoria: Searching for Spain[Eng]
programme.sub-title: 今集,伊娃探索北部的崎嶇阿斯圖里亞斯,揭示其豐富的烹飪遺產和鄉郊傳統。從有百年歷史的蘋果酒釀製,到在山洞製作的卡布拉爾斯芝士,我們跟居民和芝士製造商等一起了解大地和社區如何塑造當地食物。

Eva explores Asturias, Spain's rugged northern region, uncovering its rich culinary heritage and rural traditions. Alongside passionate cheesemakers and musician Rodrigo Cuevas, Eva explores Asturias' stunning
programme.desc: mountains, fading villages, traditional farming, and the people preserving its distinctive culture.

programme.sub-title: 東坡認為皇上應請太后回宮,被皇上下旨重打三十板。東坡向家人宣布決定辭官回鄉,此時聖旨到要擢升東坡。月娥欲以高價頂讓春釀坊;季常勸月娥收手,她反要季常簽署休書。季常等人來到城門,守衛不准他們離開......

programme.title: 高朋滿座#163[粵]
Welcome To The House#163[Can]
programme.sub-title: 不懂下廚的富太朱莉亞,將整個菜檔包下來揀菜。朋好心教授揀菜心得,但富太毫不在意。朋回到廚藝中心,發現該名富太竟是他班上的學生。朋更發現,朱莉亞對廚藝雖極有熱誠,但卻亳無天分,更弄出不少笑話,令朋燒傷。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#8[粵/普][PG]
The Legend of Heroes - Hot Blooded#8[Can/Man][PG]
programme.sub-title: 楊康被擒關在歸雲莊,他本想騙穆念慈替金人通風報信卻被識破。穆念慈給梅超風留下求救消息後被歐陽克挾持,歐陽克逼梅超風交出《九陰真經》。陸乘風收到骷髏頭,知道歸雲莊有難,此時裘千仞和六怪也來到莊內。

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社[粵]
Crazy For History[Can]
programme.sub-title: 朱元璋如何由乞丐搖身一變成為明太祖?原來當時目不識丁的他收到一封信,最後令他走上成王之路!陳世美是人所共知的宇宙最強負心男,「歷史大誤解」卻指他為官清廉,而且夫唱婦隨?「衣食住行」直擊古代樓市炒風。

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社[粵]
Crazy For History[Can]
programme.sub-title: 朱元璋出身寒微,因怕人取笑,遂大興文字獄;他設立錦衣衛對付左右朝政的開國功臣,陶傑、王晶話你知他殺得有理。明朝千億貪官劉瑾,被《亞洲華爾街日報》報道為千年以來最有錢的六個中國人,他現身講述貪官發跡史。

programme.title: 香港早晨[粵] 及 環球新聞檔案[粵]
Good Morning Hong Kong[Can] and International News File[Can]
細味文明[粵/英]
Flavors[Can/Eng]
programme.sub-title: 五漁村是意大利一個迷人岸區,由五個繽紛村落組成:蒙特羅索、韋爾納扎、科爾尼利亞、馬納羅拉和里奧馬焦雷。以雄偉懸崖、優美行山徑和地中海魅力見稱,是世界遺產。今集我們去探索其大自然、歷史和文化。

Cinque Terre, a stunning coastal region in Italy, makes up of five colorful villages: Monterosso, Vernazza, Corniglia, Manarola, and Riomaggiore. Known for its dramatic cliffs, scenic hiking trails, and Mediterranean charm, it's a
programme.desc: UNESCO World Heritage Site and a popular destination for travelers seeking natural beauty and traditional Italian culture. Let's explore Cinque Terre's nature, history, and culture together!

programme.title: 手匠傳承[粵/韓]
Handmade Wonder in Asia (II)[Can/Kor]
programme.sub-title: 峇里島是眾神之島,主流宗教為印度教。印度教神話中的動物巴龍代表善,一直守護着峇里島人。工匠以細膩的手法製作出巴龍面具,並將其利用於舞蹈和藝術表演,成為當地十分重要的文化之一。

programme.title: 世界獨特社區[粵/普]
World's Unique Neighbourhoods[Can/Man]
programme.sub-title: 台灣寶藏岩原是日本侵佔台灣期間的軍士要地,經過修繕,引入聚落共生的概念,創造聚落多元豐富的樣貌。菲律賓南部的棉蘭老島因戰事製造了許多孤兒和寡婦,地方政府積極建立婦女發展培訓中心,幫助她們自立擺脫困境。

programme.title: 仨心友行 3[粵]
Walking With You 3[Can]
programme.sub-title: 陰晴不定,下雨天的秘密花園,主持們暢玩「天下太平」。穎鏇見識那些年玩意,頓感刺激,佳芯更玩到大暴走!穎鏇引領眾人室內射籃,射術不賴,諾懿則自揭學生年代藉籃球吸引女生的經驗。型男袁偉豪應邀加入,同隨達人體驗快樂漂植。大家卻對
programme.desc: 廚餘肥料滿腔疑問,即興發揮「是非精」本色研究研究!女神們被偉豪牽動感情世界,談及分手經歷與情緒反思,直接歷練戀愛成長。緩和氣氛,眾人挑戰升級版「冚棉胎」,超高分貝下,勝負如何?

programme.title: 豪遊咖啡[粵]
Guru Coffee Tour[Can]
programme.sub-title: 深水埗近年湧現不少文青咖啡店,Mo走進韓風咖啡酒吧,店內咖啡也會加入韓式元素?由舊布行改建的咖啡店,可找到港產咖啡豆,Mo試味後大讚有驚喜;Ben到訪的另一間咖啡店則會用本地出產的蜜糖沖Latte。一間以童話小鎮風格裝潢的咖啡
programme.desc: 店,出售的咖啡也充滿童話色彩。有咖啡店的地上鋪滿沙粒,配合影像效果令客人彷彿置身海灘般。在這個寫意環境下,Ben與嘉賓黃智雯共享咖啡時光,智雯還會暢談Ben最有魅力的一次。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷[粵]
ChatSAT2026[Can]
programme.sub-title: 健力士世界紀錄是全球權威的世界紀錄認證機構,專職審核並記錄各個領域的「世界之最」。其紀錄涵蓋人類、動植物等十二大類別,而全球平均每幾小時就可能有一項新紀錄誕生,谷主汛文自言曾是某項世界紀錄的保持者?汛文細述申請健力士世
programme.desc: 界紀錄的嚴格規則與流程,並設計了互動問答,讓拍檔猜猜無法獲得官方認證的奇葩項目。另外,她更盤點了多項趣味十足的世界紀錄,當揭曉「生產最多的女性」所誕下嬰兒數量,谷主瀅仴滿臉震驚!

programme.title: 滙豐Premier Elite呈獻:《滙豐Premier E
HSBC Premier Elite Presents:HSBC Premier Elite Wealth Studio
programme.sub-title: 金融市場瞬息萬變,加上科技發展日新月異,如何影響投資市場?《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》,雲集不同行業專家,剖析市場趨勢,講解金融、投資及理財等話題,務求做到深入淺出,
programme.desc: 聚焦分析不同議題,為大家捕捉市場先機。

programme.title: 開心大綜藝之暑假玩到盡[粵][PG]
Have A Big Laugh![Can][PG]
programme.sub-title: 校長Bob、訓導主任區永權繼續開班,還請來Miss陳庭欣共同主持大局。玩「一二三紅綠燈」分組,每位學生都想與楊潮凱同班,何廣沛慘被嫌棄!吹啤牌回合,廣沛那班果然「不負眾望」,連環被罰兩大杯「特飲」。浮台上
programme.desc: 搶飛碟力爭加分,周志康發揮所長表現自己,而翟威廉遭斥罵後,轉頭竟被大讚?校長藉遊戲讓同學「出口術」爭取拍劇做主角,何泳芍的答案被質疑,但配上動作即可逆轉過關?校長最後親自「上課」答題,竟淪為雪人!

programme.title: 香港婚後事[粵][PG]
And They Lived Happily Ever After?[Can][PG]
programme.sub-title: 網絡盛行改變了男女風氣,張振朗、朱敏瀚同來談論《婚後事》中提及的「約炮世代、性愛分開」。假設在子女身上發生,敏瀚、天宇同稱對仔女態度不一!延伸討論約炮界線,多人運動實難接受。對於初相識的心儀女生主動邀上門「飲咖啡」,
programme.desc: 可會受落?談到成家立室,在場三位未婚男認為甚麼最重要?諾懿當初被指與太太背景懸殊,他訴說結婚心態。倘若知己慰玲仍單身,可有發展空間?敏瀚稱難認同她的放養式育兒法,振朗則笑言諗起就想嘔!

Hong Kong Stories - Global Gastronomy (English Version)
programme.desc: 《非常老撾菜》帶觀眾走進香港罕見的老撾飲食世界,探索這片金三角樞紐的獨特風味。主持Andy Dark 親身品嚐「是冧彈雞見求」等龍坡邦菜式,揭開老撾菜的秘密,當中還有四色糯米飯,以及介紹以蘇木、蜜蒙花染色的藥膳文化。
Extraordinary Lao Cuisine takes audiences into the rarely seen world of Lao dining in Hong Kong to explore the unique flavors of this Golden Triangle hub.

programme.title: 夜.遊香港 ( 英文版)[英]
Twilight Trails: Hong Kong
programme.desc: 零零後,可以是時間,可以是一個年代,也可以是一個標籤。在這個充滿標籤的世界,00後又怎樣看待午夜零時的香港?
Post-00s (Gen Z) can refer to a point in time, an era, or a label. In this world full of labels, how do the post-00s view Hong Kong at the stroke of midnight?

programme.title: 照顧者們
Stories about Carers
programme.desc: 年近九十歲胡伯獨力尋找新居、搬家,更要照顧跌傷腳後無力自理的麥婆婆,麥婆婆掙扎苦思半年後,終下定決心到院舍入住。胡伯堅持每天探望。二人重新找到生活等節奏。大坑西重建在即,二人重遊勾起半生回憶,對將來亦重燃寄望。
At nearly 90 years old, Uncle Wu had to find a new home and move on his own while also caring for Grandma Mak, who was unable to take care of herself after injuring her leg.

programme.desc: 色所震懾。接着要步行九公里前往營地,為登「劍峰」作準備,途中遇上大雨,一行人幾近濕透,還要在泥濘積水的叢林行走。時間逐漸緊迫,敏芝卻感到力有不逮,奶仔於是背着她而行,能否順利抵達目的地?

programme.sub-title: 一到清晨,奶仔、敏芝和製作組便踏上了攀爬海拔千二米「劍峰」之旅。奶仔沿途緊張敏芝的安全,並教她一些行山知識,惟敏芝真的力有不逮,為免阻礙團隊於預定時間內抵達山峰,兩人決定「拆Team」分批向上走。奶仔自認在敏芝面前

programme.sub-title: 後生仔可有想過創業?後生仔2.0之一的李嘉豪(Alston)偕同女友歐卓妍到臨,分享作為手工藝創業者的心路歷程。二人合作開設工作室,分別主理木製工藝與陶藝。GM與波波前往工作室,先跟卓妍學造陶藝,KOL們的「悉心」設計,
programme.desc: 經過燒製與上色等步驟,成品望落不差,卓妍對兩位學生的評價如何?Alston和卓妍對手工藝創作充滿熱誠,開設工作室的初心是甚麼?相關的開業成本、預算,從創業到經營,統統都唔簡單!

programme.title: #後生仔傾吓偈[粵]
Young And Restless[Can]
programme.sub-title: 李嘉豪(Alston)和女友歐卓妍繼續分享創業點滴,創業除了需要資金,還要兼顧不少雜務,二人認為甚麼最難搞?另邊廂,GM與波波跟Alston上木藝工作坊,製作「創意」十足的餐具,經過打磨修飾,成品怎樣?Alston與卓妍
programme.desc: 身為工藝班導師,不時遇到無禮貌、乏耐性、欠尊重等麻煩系學生,會如何應對那些無奈時刻?情侶檔合作做生意或能令雙方更明瞭彼此工作,但亦可能是感情的考驗。而後生仔最怕遇上怎樣的生意拍檔?

programme.title: 唔滾唔知有料到[粵]
Boil It Up[Can]
programme.sub-title: 重慶河鮮不絕,必吃麻辣魚火鍋。烏魚、豆花滾煮後,口感滑嫩;龍眼又甜又辣,出奇地夾!如嫌口味太辣,可飲茉莉花豆漿解解辣。麻辣湯底是靈魂,加入酸辣椒、豆母子等配料,滋味層次昇華;主廚亦一展將烏魚起肉「開花」功架。串串香火鍋結
programme.desc: 合烤串、打邊爐風味,食材多變、價格親民。麻辣鍋底滾折耳根夾牛肉,竟有豬內臟味道?清淡的耗兒魚、泥鰍魚最後下鍋,還能吸盡湯汁精華。隨主廚學串豬腰片,韻婷求快捷耍小聰明,能否過關?

programme.title: 向世界挑戰[粵/普]
Challenge the World[Can/Man]
programme.sub-title: 本集將派出新加坡女藝人謝韻儀前往澳洲埃文代爾,參加一項被列入健力士世界紀錄的高輪單車比賽。雖然同樣是單車家族,但高輪單車的構造有別於一般的單車,要駕馭它也需要不同的技巧,韻儀能否挑戰成功呢?

programme.title: 3日2夜[粵]
Fun Abroad[Can]
programme.sub-title: 馬爾代夫是千島之國,張曦雯再「玩轉」兩個島,前往距離首都馬利約35分鐘船程的卡尼島,入住佈置較傳統的水上屋,挑戰獨木舟、水上滑翔傘及傳統綫釣。環境優雅寧靜的翡諾島,距離卡尼島只是5分鐘船程,曦雯在提供私人管家服務的水上泳池屋安
programme.desc: 頓後,租船出海浮潛,之後享受昆達利尼背部按摩療程,並把握時間,在飯前享用一杯翡諾島特色飲品Fino Colada;飯後她還參與「馬爾代夫之夜」表演,大跳馬爾代夫傳統舞蹈。

programme.title: 關注關注組[粵]
Eyes On Concern Groups[Can]
programme.sub-title: 除了奶茶之外,檸檬茶亦是港式地道飲品。竣陞認為在茶餐廳點喝凍檸茶,必需少甜、少冰?十郎提到其童年時香港流行粉裝沖泡檸檬茶,他更喜愛只吃粉劑。某連鎖茶餐廳的凍檸茶,因不含原片檸檬,在網上劣評如潮。日行一心「試伏」,嚐後竟覺不錯
programme.desc: ?兩人還分別點喝泰式與手打檸檬茶,某杯被批二十分難飲。除了日行曾試飲的連鎖茶記出品,他們還準備了茶包、茶粉、盒裝檸檬茶,與拍檔舉行盲試大會,但某款被美貽、竣陞直言味道像洗潔精?

programme.title: 喂喂喂 你話你係邊個邊個[粵]
Now I Know You[Can]
programme.sub-title: 裝修木工師傅李文偉,分享對「木」的迷戀。將木連繫生活,走進溫暖的沖曬店,咖啡區以柔和色調打造,他訴說對每件木家具的細緻執着。文偉為攝影工作室裝修,背後流露滿滿的人情味。回想艱巨的溫室工程,見證汗水換來的成果,猶
programme.desc: 如人生縮影,辛苦但值得。另會參觀文偉的專屬小天地兼放空空間。文偉亦是音樂人,音樂賦予他甚麼意義?將音樂、木工兩項最愛的興趣連結,滿足感難以言喻。文偉忙於工作,犧牲了陪伴妻兒的時間,不免感慨。

programme.title: #後生仔傾吓偈[粵]
Young And Restless[Can]

programme.desc: 好幸福。陸永難忘開騷獲神級前輩撐場,至今仍然回味,提及「人前人後一個樣」的藝人,眾人發現陸永的理解竟與大家有出入?家樂還透露當網台主持期間出錯令受訪者有微言,也算是吸取了經驗。

programme.desc: 即衝前營救!事後紫恩依然毫無懼色,只顧回味海底世界的夢幻畫面。一行人坐船轉到較深海域欣賞珊瑚,奶仔不斷提醒紫恩「最緊要安全」,還一直從旁照顧。潛水後享用豐富海鮮餐,紫恩揀海鮮時終於識驚?

programme.desc: 考驗他,最終會呈現怎樣的美食?阿峰想餵女神吃甜品,怎料卻被堅決拒絕。楨怡要為約會評分,一百分為滿分,阿峰竟只得五分?楨怡還分享對伴侶的要求,首要條件是比她高;若然對方是控制型男友,她亦可接受!

programme.title: 美食新聞報道[粵]
Gourmet Express[Can]
programme.sub-title: 陳國強師傅推介馬來西亞一間備受廚師喜愛的酒家,主打野生河鮮及海鮮佳餚。芝士醬野生大河蝦爽口彈牙,「芝味」無窮;蔥薑油蒸極品野生果皇巴丁魚,肉質鮮嫩兼帶獨特果香;焦糖黑叉燒外脆內嫩,軟腍多汁。施焯日帶行仔享用只需128元的酒
